B0.name: causal persistence
B0.definition: prediction = latest usable target-station PM2.5 observation available at the forecast origin
rule: if PM2.5 is observed at the origin, predict that value
otherwise apply the frozen causal policy: carry the most recent observation within 6 hours
if no observation exists within the 6-hour ceiling, predict the station training PM2.5 median
B0.horizon_dependence: same rule at every horizon; only the origin moves

B1.name: daily seasonal naive
B1.definition: prediction = PM2.5 observed at target_timestamp - 24 h
usable_only_if: the observation is causally available at the origin
B1.coincidence_note: at h = 24 the seasonal lag equals the origin, so B1 reduces to B0. This is expected and will be reported, not hidden.
B1.weekly_rejected_because: training PM2.5 autocorrelation at 168 h was approximately 0.008

B2.name: training climatology
B2.definition: deterministic lookup of a training-only median
hierarchy: station x month x hour median

B3.name: gradient-boosted causal lag-feature baseline
B3.definition: supervised gradient boosting over causal features derived from the canonical 48-hour window
B3.obligation: The implementation package and hyperparameter grid MUST be frozen and recorded at the start of Phase 3, before any validation metric is computed. They must never be chosen from observed performance.

feature_contract.lag_max_justification: lag 47 is the oldest position inside the canonical [origin-47, origin] window; lag 48 would require a hidden 49th hour and is therefore excluded
